[[Droknar's Motivation Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from the [[Paragon's Chest]] in the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Motivation]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Stone Summit Shield]]; however, it is colored a bluish green

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Daedal Shield]] from collector [[Lahati]] or crafters [[Hahbe]], [[Kol Swordshanks]], [[Asiri]], or [[Aksah]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Motivation]] [[shield]]s:
**[[Aureate Aegis]] from collectors [[Marduc Snakeslayer]] or [[Pekk]]
**[[Heraldic Shield]] from collectors [[Dobb]], [[Traybor Edwards]], or [[Sark]]
**[[Destroyer Shield]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Shield]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shield]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Luck of the Draw]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Motivation]] [[shield]]s:
**[[Daedal Shield]] from collectors [[Kaya]] or [[Roland le Moisson]] or crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Shield]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Shield]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Shield]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Shield]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Shield]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Shield of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Shield of the Wing]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
**[[Charr Shield]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Mursaat Shield]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Shield]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Shield]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Shield Handle]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Luck of the Draw]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Mallyx's Motivation]], [[Cyndr's Aegis]], [[Wandalz's Refuge]], [[Bastion of the Condemned]], and the [[Motivation]] versions of [[Exalted Aegis]] and [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)]] have stats identical to this item.

*[[Mallyx's Supremacy]], [[Shagu's Anthem]], [[Droknar's Command Shield]], [[Shield of the Condemned]], and the [[Command]] versions of [[Exalted Aegis]] and [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require [[Command]].
